name: Bando (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Bando city emblem in green and blue: a green stylised letter V beside a blue curved stroke with two green discs.
history: Municipal flag of Bando, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 22 September 2005.

features.role: Bando city emblem — a green stylised letter V beside a blue curved stroke with two green discs
